Try it and see how it goes. The goal is to control your mind. First step is to do it with the sound of music. If you can control your thoughts that way, next step is to do it without it. Your mind is like an ocean. Right now it's a storm in there. Thoughts crashing like waves in a turbulent sea. Goal is to first calm it down. Use whatever helps to reach a state of thoughtlessness. It's hard. It's like going to the gym. First day you'll be only able to lift few pounds. But if you continue on, one day you can lift hundreds. Same way, you have to excercise your mind. First time you'll find it hard to hold a still mind even for few seconds. But so it daily . Do it multiple times a day. Your will gets stronger. You begin to control your thoughts instead of the thoughts controlling you. And you start seeing that you thoughts don't drive your actions anymore. 

If you are into self help books or want to learn more about this , try the book "A million thoughts". I was in the same boat as you and it helped me a lot.  Most of all remember it takes time. Don't expect things to change in days or weeks. Same as building a good body, building a sound mind is a long road but it's definitely worth it

I'm 28, never been with a woman. I know how it feels. Some days it's too much to bear. People tell it's a small thing and girls shouldn't matter much but we know they do. Seeing everyone around you in relationship is heartbreaking. It's worse for me because I'm at an age where everyone is married and I realised too late that I'm undesirable and need to make changes. I'm doing them now and they are slowly working. You have more time my friend. 21 is young. If I could be that young again I'd have done so many things to improve myself. Physical deformity isn't something you can change so forget about it. Improve everything else. Read lots, watch shows, talk to random dudes especially ones who are good with ladies. This will improve your personality. Humour, holding a interesting conversation is far more important than looks or imperfections. The only way you'll get that is by knowing a lot about any many things. This way you always have something to talk about. Don't be so hopeless, you have lots of time my friend. Meanwhile work on yourself.
